author: B. P. Huynh
title: City of Eagle announces temporary closure of Dry Creek and Laguna Pointe trails
text:
The City of Eagle announced on April 22 that both the Dry Creek Trail and Laguna Pointe Trail are temporarily closed due to flooding. The closures affect the section of Dry Creek Trail between West State Street and Highway 44, located on the west side of the Eagle Naz Church property, as well as an unpaved portion of Laguna Pointe Trail along the greenbelt south of the river east of Eagle Road.
These trail closures occur regularly in spring when water levels rise. Rainfall and snowmelt contribute to increased releases from Lucky Peak, which in turn raises flow levels in the Boise River. As a result, these conditions can lead to flooding along recreational paths near waterways.
The city is advising residents and visitors to exercise extra caution when recreating around rivers during periods of high water flow. Such precautions are important for public safety until conditions improve and trails can be reopened.
No timeline has been provided for reopening these sections, but officials note that closures are expected each year during this season due to natural factors influencing river flows.
